next.reason: 1985 GR3: 'All other figurative constants belong to the category alphanumeric' and 'e. All other elementary moves are legal', so MOVE QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE or ALL literal to a numeric or numeric-edited item is legal 1985. §2023:14.9.25.3 SR5 refuses it at compile time: 'the move of an alphanumeric figurative constant (SPACE, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, ALL literal, or ALL symbolic-character) to either a numeric item or a numeric-edited item is prohibited', save ALL digits to an integer item. The rest is kept: the elementary-move definition (§2023:14.9.25.4 GR4), literal and figurative-constant categories (§2023:14.9.25.4 GR7), item categories (§2023:13.18.40.4 GR3), ZERO not to alphabetic (§2023:14.9.25.3 SR6) and prohibitions a-d via Table 16 (§2023:14.9.25.3 SR10).
